title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna against GPT-5.6
summary: OpenAI halved token prices for its mid and low tiers. Independent measurement confirms cost per task roughly halves, driven entirely by price: both models use slightly more output tokens than before, and Luna's benchmark score dropped two points.

claims.text: GPT-6 Sol costs half as much as GPT-5.6 Sol
claims.scopeNote: OpenAI states the cut per token; this checks it per completed task.

ref.note: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2, both at max effort.

claims.text: GPT-6 Luna cuts prices by about half

ref.note: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2, both at max effort.

claims.text: Sol makes about half as many factual mistakes as GPT-5.6 Sol
claims.noRefNote: OpenAI's figure comes from its own set of user-flagged conversations. Artificial Analysis reports its knowledge and hallucination index rising from 22 to 27, which points the same way but measures something different. Test it with a factual task set of your own.

observations.text: The saving comes from price: output tokens per task rose slightly, from about 29k to 31k for Sol and 41k to 51k for Luna.
Independent evals show regressions too: Sol dropped about 100 Elo on GDPval-AA v2.1, a benchmark of economically valuable tasks.
Prompts above 272K input tokens are billed at higher long-context rates, so very long-context workloads save less.

livePack.note: Runs the 15 starter tasks plus 7 multi-step efficiency tasks. Add tasks from your own work before trusting a verdict.

extraTasks.prompt: A train leaves at 09:40 and arrives at 13:05 the same day. How many minutes is the journey? Answer with the number only.
How many positive integers below 100 are divisible by 3 or by 5? Answer with the number only.
If today is Wednesday, what day of the week will it be 100 days from today? Answer with the day name only.
A shop gives 20% off, then a further 10% off the reduced price. What is the total discount as a percentage of the original price? Answer with the number only.
Which is the largest of these: 3/7, 0.45, 4/9, 0.43? Answer with the value exactly as written in the list.
Return only JSON with keys "po" and "total" (total as a number, in rupees) for this order: "PO-7781 for 12 units at Rs 1,250 each."
How many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) are in the word "transformation"? Answer with the number only.
